Antibiotics in meat on the rise worldwide, especially bacon

We are always told that the reason antibiotics are becoming resistant is that too many people are taking them when they are sick with a standard virus. That pales in comparison to the amount we regularly ingest in our meat products. Scary that we haven't put a stop to this practice even if it makes meat more expensive.

Agree. We need to stop feeding these antibiotics, hormones, growth stimulaters to our food. Reduce animal densities, improve husbandry so these drugs are not required except in cases of normal illness. Meat would be more expensive but not that much if we went back to grass fed/pastured animals, restoring grazing land and hay growing, and stopped producing all the corn and soy to feed livestock and make into other products. This will not happen without a government ban which meat producers will howl like mashed cats when they hear mentioned.

Ha! Mashed cats.

With regulation of anything going on the wayside, these issues have to be up to us to tackle. There's just so much wrong, it's difficult to even know where to start. I suppose the rootstriker in me would shoot for Citizen's United first. Representative democracy is dead.
